components.name: Button
components.description: Figma description: 'Primary and secondary action buttons. Height 44, radius radius/md (8px), label Body/Semibold.' In get_metadata the wrapper 1:38 is a plain frame containing two variant symbols; design context exposes props variant: Primary|Secondary and label (default 'Button'). Instances on screens are 120x44, except full-width 560x44 (Checkout submit 3:51) and 400x44 (Login submit 3:76).

screens.name: Home / Desktop
keyElements: Header 64px: Logo (left), Main nav right-aligned: 'Home', 'Shop all products', 'Checkout' link with Cart badge (text '0'), 'Sign in to your account'
Product grid: 3 Product cards (3 columns, 341.33px wide each) each with Name, Description, Price and Button instance (120x44)

screens.name: Home / Mobile
keyElements: Header 64px: Logo and 40x40 Menu button (icon glyph text) at x=326 replacing the desktop nav
Hero: Title wraps to 2 lines (96px high), Subtitle 2 lines (48px)
Product grid: 3 Product cards stacked in 1 column (342px wide, 24px gap), each with Name, Description, Price, Button (120x44)

screens.name: Checkout / Desktop
keyElements: Same header as Home; Cart badge text '2'
Order items list with 2 Order lines: 'Ceramic Mug × 1' $18.00 and 'Canvas Tote × 1' $24.00, each with a 'Remove' text action
Coupon: Label, Coupon input (432x44) + Button (120x44), Success message text
Summary rows: Subtotal, Discount, Total (Total row is larger, 28px text)

screens.name: Login / Desktop
keyElements: Same header as Home; Cart badge text '2'

Sign in form (400px wide, left-aligned in container): Title (H1), 'Field / Email' label + 44px input, 'Field / Password' label + 44px input (Value text nodes have width 0, i.e. empty, no placeholder text), full-width Button (400x44)

layoutRules.rule: Page shell: full-width Header 64px tall, then Main; content Container is 1120px wide, horizontally centred (x=160 at 1440), with 24px inner gutter (content width 1072px).
Desktop header: Logo at x=24; nav right-aligned ending at x=1416 (24px right gutter), items 'Home', 'Shop all products', 'Checkout' (+ cart badge 20x20), 'Sign in to your account' with 24px gaps.
layoutRules.evidence: Main nav 2:5 x=890 w=526; children x=0,70,228,350 (gaps 24)

layoutRules.rule: Mobile header replaces the nav with a 40x40 menu button at the right (x=326, 24px right gutter); nav links are not shown in the mobile frame.
layoutRules.evidence: Menu button 2:42 x=326 w=40 in a 390 frame; no Main nav in 2:40

layoutRules.rule: Mobile main content is full-width (Container 390px wide, x=0) with 24px side gutters (content 342px).
Product grid: 3 equal columns with 24px gap at desktop (341.33px each); collapses to 1 column (342px, 24px row gap) at mobile.
Product card content is stacked vertically: Name, Description, Price, Button (120x44, not stretched); cards are 198px tall in both viewports.
layoutRules.evidence: Product card children positions in 2:21 and 2:52

layoutRules.rule: Hero title/subtitle wrap on mobile (Title 96px = 2 lines at 48px line height; Subtitle 48px = 2 lines) vs single line on desktop.
Checkout and Login content are single narrow columns left-aligned inside the container (Checkout 560px, Sign in form 400px); no side panel is shown.
Order lines are rows: item text left, price and 'Remove' action right; Summary rows have label left and value right-aligned to the 560px edge.
Coupon row: input (432px) + 8px gap + Button (120px) = 560px; Success message under the row.
Interactive controls (Buttons, Inputs) are 44px high (size/control-height); Buttons in full-width contexts stretch to container width (560 / 400).
The design only has a mobile (390) and a desktop (1440) variant of Home; Checkout and Login exist only at desktop 1440.

unknowns: Screenshots: only Home / Desktop (2:2) was rendered at 1x (1440x542). get_screenshot for Home / Mobile (2:39), Checkout / Desktop (3:8) and Login / Desktop (3:53) failed with the Figma MCP Starter-plan tool call limit, so those screens were not rendered and their key elements come from get_metadata node names only.
